verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एतस्मिन्नन्तरे प्राप्ता लोकप्रावृत्तिका नराः। चक्रायुधगृहं सर्वे लोकपालगृहोपमम्॥१॥
verses.english: And when demon काल-नेमि strutted on battlefield clipping demon मय he shone forth like विष्णु walking with Mt. मन्दर…

verses.sanskrit: तेष्वात्ययिकशंसीषु लोकप्रावृत्तिकेष्विह। कृतसंज्ञा यदुश्रेष्ठाः समेताः कृष्णसंसदि॥२॥
verses.english: One insurgent into other’s camp mutually trampled their enemies underfoot and when they are weltering like that the battlefield appeared like an ocean commixed with the riptides of eastern and western oceans…
verses.bhavadeepa: सप्तचत्वारिंशकेऽस्मिश्चराणां वचनादथ। कृष्णस्येच्छा हि रुक्मिण्यां कुण्डिने गमनं तथा॥१॥ एतस्मिन्निति। प्रावृत्तिकाः प्रवृत्तिसूचकाः॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: समागतेषु सर्वेषु यदुमुख्येषु संसदि। प्रावृत्तिका नराः प्राहुः पार्थिवात्ययिकं वचः॥३॥
verses.english: Those that are the principal frontline warriors on the side of demon मय, they have come forward for battling delightedly and fearlessly… some them are:

verses.sanskrit: जनार्दन नरेन्द्राणां पार्थिवानां समागमः।  भविष्यति क्षितीशानां समूढानामनेकशः॥४॥
verses.english: As soon as the punishing flashes of lightning, or the showers of thunderbolts, or whatever shockers used by gods fell on the body of काल-नेमि, they all became self-smashed smithers, like clouds fizzling out after discharge…

verses.sanskrit: त्वरितास्तत्र गच्छन्ति नानाजनपदेश्वराः। कुण्डिने पुण्डरीकाक्ष भोजपुत्रस्य शासनात्॥५॥
verses.english: Then in battle, gods began to throw dreadful thunderbolts and excellent lances and clubs at dAnavA-s, while the dAnavA-s began to discharge massive clubs and other assault weapons on gods…

verses.sanskrit: प्रकाशं स्म कथास्तत्र श्रूयन्ते मनुजेरिताः। रुक्मिणी किल नामास्ति रुक्मिणः प्रथमा स्वसा॥६॥
verses.english: काल-नेमि also detained raingod वरुण in that war rendering him as a barren cloud, bared ocean and bared of his lasso, whereby he barely had any activity to do…

verses.sanskrit: भावी स्वयंवरस्तत्र तस्याः किल जनार्दन। इत्यर्थमेते सबला गच्छन्ति मनुजाधिपाः॥७॥
verses.english: On the other hand the army of the gods under the command of इन्द्र also shone forth with the resplendence of the sunrays as well with the cool beams of moon … expeditious like life-giving air, peaceable in compose, hoister of detached yet assorted starscape- streamers, wearer of whiffling clouds as its wigwagging raiment, and smiley sporting the smiling stars and planets… that army which is a dedicatee of nArAyaNa is shielded by इन्द्र, वरुण and कुबेर, and irradiated by firegod and airgod for a good measure… with the effluence of a tiding ocean that army of gods shone forth with every weapon and with the enlisted yakshA-s and gandharvA-s, magnificently and venturesomely…

verses.sanskrit: तस्यास्त्रैलोक्यसुन्दर्यास्तृतीयेऽहनि यादव। रुक्मभूषणभूषिण्या भविष्यति स्वयंवरः॥८॥
verses.english: Seeing all this, the great असुर काल-नेमि, the son of demon-king ह्रण्य-कशिपु, who is already worked up with anger, because sometime back gods felled his father, is now brimming with continued war-enthusiasm, like an extensile cloud continuously filled with the tides of an ocean making a sternway…

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञां तत्र समेताणां हस्त्यश्वरथगामिनाम्। द्रक्ष्यामः शतशस्तत्र शिबिराणि महात्मनाम्॥९॥
verses.english: The sky appeared to have enshrouded with his sprawling arms that are like the ridgy mountaintops, some which are ready with various weapons like bows and maces and some of which are flinging other missilery…

verses.sanskrit: सिंहशार्दूलदृप्तानां मत्तद्विरदगामिनाम्। सदा युद्धप्रियाणां हि परस्परममर्षिणाम्॥१०॥
verses.english: One insurgent into other’s camp mutually trampled their enemies underfoot and when they are weltering like that the battlefield appeared like an ocean commixed with the riptides of eastern and western oceans…

verses.sanskrit: जयाय शीघ्रं सहिता बलौघेन समन्विताः। निरुद्धाः पृथिवीपालाः किमेकान्तचरा वयम्॥११॥
verses.english: Like two different and inimical herds of elephants bumping headlong, one coming from blossomy forests and the other from boorish highlands, the gods of rosy sky clashed with the surly demons of netherworld, filling whole sky and all quarters not in one way but with a pastiche of rumpuses from shrilling conches, thumping war-drums, twanging bowstrings, swishing bows, like the elephants that sonorously fill their ambience with blares, blasts and trumpets, beneath which noise level the hey-s, ho-s and hails of demons subsided…

verses.sanskrit: निरुत्साहा भविष्यामो गच्छामो यदुनन्दन। श्रुत्वैतत्केशवो वाक्यं हृदि शल्यमिवार्पितम्। निर्जगाम यदुश्रेष्ठो यदूनां सहितो बलैः॥१२॥
verses.english: Some are fighting hand to hand, some felling the other; some are in wrestlers’ arm-lock; some other duel-enthusiasts grappling one another…
verses.bhavadeepa: निरुद्धा रुक्मिणीलिप्सयेति शेषः। तत्र वयं किं भिल्लवदेकान्तचराः येन निरुत्साहा भविष्यामः। अपि तु अतिप्रसिद्धास्तेन सोत्साहा एव तत्र गच्छाम इति सार्द्धश्लोकवाक्यम्॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: यादवास्ते बलोदग्राः सर्वे सङ्ग्रामलालसाः। निर्ययुः स्यन्दनवरैर्गर्वितास्त्रिदशा इव॥१३॥
verses.english: Then in battle, gods began to throw dreadful thunderbolts and excellent lances and clubs at dAnavA-s, while the dAnavA-s began to discharge massive clubs and other assault weapons on gods…

verses.sanskrit: बलाग्रेण नियुक्तेन हरिरीशानसंमतः। चक्रोद्यतकरः कृष्णो गदापाणिर्व्यरोचत॥१४॥
verses.english: His wind fluttered attire, ochreish silks with blackish borders that approximate with an ocherish sky at eventide and with black-bordered tongues of flames, speaks of the rustling heat and tonguing flames of animosity in him towards gods, whereby he approximates himself with Mt. मेरु, around which mountain the heat of eventide and the flutter of tongues of flames are usual, wherefore he stood out in the van of army as if he is another Mt. मेरु surrounded by such a bustling heat and tonguing flames…

verses.sanskrit: यादवाश्चापरे तत्र वासुदेवानुयायिनः। रथैरादित्यसङ्काशैः किङ्किणीप्रतिनादितैः॥१५॥
verses.english: When demons extolled काल-नेमि on battlefield for his exploits, as a husbander of all created beings, as an all-inclusive world, as an all-in-one scare of the world, as a single-bodied quarter-guard-gods of ten quarters, as the soul of the sun, moon and all other planets, as a subverter of air and fire gods, and as one who on conquering all worlds ascended to the seat of creator brahma, bringing original brahma to naught… that demon काल-नेमि shone forth on battlefield as de facto brahma…

verses.sanskrit: उग्रसेनं तु गोविन्दः प्राह निश्चितदर्शनः। तिष्ठ त्वं नृपशार्दूल भ्रात्रा मे सहितोऽनघ॥१६॥
verses.english: His arms outstretched straight and awry on the sky where each arm appeared as a five-headed black cobra; fingers are like hoods, five-fingered-hands are like five-hoods, when related each to each; and they looked springy with fanged mouths agape, split tongues agile…

verses.sanskrit: क्षत्रिया विकृतिप्रज्ञाः शास्त्रनिश्चितदर्शनाः। पुरीं शून्यामिमां वीर जघन्येऽभिपतन्ति ह॥१७॥
verses.english: The sound of those chariots which are already trundling grew terrible like the rumblings of clouds in the sky…

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकं शङ्किताः सर्वे जरासन्धवशानुगाः। मोदन्ते सुखिनस्तत्र देवलोके यथामराः॥१८॥
verses.english: Some are demolishing enemy chariots, while some more are barricading them, but some more could not do anything as their chariots are stranded in traffic jams on roads with one-way-traffic – एक संबाधम्…
verses.bhavadeepa: विकृतिप्रज्ञाः कपटबुद्धयः शास्त्रनिश्चितदर्शनाः राजनीतिविदः जघन्ये मम पृष्ठतः शून्ये इत्यर्थः॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भोजराजो महायशाः। कृष्णस्नेहेन विकृतं बभाषे वचनामृतम्॥१९॥
verses.english: While some from the warring factions are colliding, some are cowering, and some chariots are upheaving others chariots, while some footsoldiers are flooring enemy footsoldiers…

verses.sanskrit: कृष्ण कृष्ण महाबाहो यदूनां नन्दिवर्द्धन। श्रूयतां यदहं त्वद्य वक्ष्यामि रिपुसूदन॥२०॥
verses.english: Then there ensued a collision between those two armies of gods and demons that can be likened to the collision of earth and heaven at era-end…

verses.sanskrit: त्वया विहीनाः सर्वे स्म न शक्ताः सुखमासितुम्। पुरेऽस्मिन्विषयान्ते वा पतिहीना इव स्त्रियः॥२१॥
verses.english: That tumulus war between gods and demons is calamitous since it is fraught with missiles and grapplers, also replete with obtuse weapons like clubs, maces, cudgels etc, of them numerous are already discharged, and innumerable are yet to be discharged as they are still now being brandished…

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्सनाथा वयं तात त्वद्बाहुबलमाश्रिताः। बिभीमो न नरेन्द्राणां सेन्द्राणामपि मानद॥२२॥
verses.english: Some are fighting hand to hand, some felling the other; some are in wrestlers’ arm-lock; some other duel-enthusiasts grappling one another…

verses.sanskrit: विजयाय यदुश्रेष्ठ यत्र यत्र गमिष्यसि। तत्र त्वं सहितोऽस्माभिर्गच्छेथा यादवर्षभ॥२३॥
verses.english: Seeing all this, the great असुर काल-नेमि, the son of demon-king ह्रण्य-कशिपु, who is already worked up with anger, because sometime back gods felled his father, is now brimming with continued war-enthusiasm, like an extensile cloud continuously filled with the tides of an ocean making a sternway…

verses.sanskrit: तस्य राज्ञो वचः श्रुत्वा सस्मितं देवकीसुतः। यथेष्टं भवतामद्य तथा कर्तास्म्यसंशयम्॥२४॥
verses.english: Once इन्द्र felled flying mountains by clipping their wings using his weapon thunderbolt, but काल-नेमि felled lofty gods with trees growing on mountaintops uprooted just by his leg side gusts…

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एवमुक्त्वा तु वै कृष्णो जगामाशु रथेन वै। भीष्मकस्य गृहं प्राप्तो लोहितायति भास्करे॥२५॥
verses.english: Like two different and inimical herds of elephants bumping headlong, one coming from blossomy forests and the other from boorish highlands, the gods of rosy sky clashed with the surly demons of netherworld, filling whole sky and all quarters not in one way but with a pastiche of rumpuses from shrilling conches, thumping war-drums, twanging bowstrings, swishing bows, like the elephants that sonorously fill their ambience with blares, blasts and trumpets, beneath which noise level the hey-s, ho-s and hails of demons subsided…

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्ते राजसमाजे तु शिबिराकीर्णभूतले। रङ्गं सुविपुलं दृष्ट्वा राजसीं तनुमाविशत्॥२६॥
verses.english: His arms outstretched straight and awry on the sky where each arm appeared as a five-headed black cobra; fingers are like hoods, five-fingered-hands are like five-hoods, when related each to each; and they looked springy with fanged mouths agape, split tongues agile…

verses.sanskrit: वित्रासनार्थं भूपानां प्रकाशार्थं पुरातनम्। मनसा चिन्तयामास वैनतेयं महाबलम्॥२७॥
verses.english: The sky appeared to have enshrouded with his sprawling arms that are like the ridgy mountaintops, some which are ready with various weapons like bows and maces and some of which are flinging other missilery…

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चिन्तितमात्रस्तु विदित्वा विनतात्मजः। सुखलक्ष्यं वपुः कृत्वा निलिल्ये केशवान्तिके॥२८॥
verses.english: He stood there furiously suspiring, repeatedly frowning and copiously sweating… with these his face appeared to be shedding fiery air in suspires, embers in looks, hot-springs in sweat…

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पक्षनिपातेन पवनोद्भ्रान्तकारिणा। कम्पिता मनुजाः सर्वे न्युब्जाश्च पतिता भुवि॥२९॥
verses.english: Once इन्द्र felled flying mountains by clipping their wings using his weapon thunderbolt, but काल-नेमि felled lofty gods with trees growing on mountaintops uprooted just by his leg side gusts…

verses.sanskrit: गरुडाभिहताः सर्वे प्रचेष्टन्तो यथोरगाः। तान्सन्निपतितान्दृष्ट्वा कृष्णो गिरिरिवाचलः॥३०॥
verses.english: When काल-नेमि assaulted some chiefs of gods, यक्शा-s, गन्धर्वा-s, and उरगा-s, some with fists, some with bare hands and some others with handheld weapons, the heads and chests of some of them are mangled, some are floored, while some more are defoliated of their limbs, and many more are out of kilter and fell in his fore…
verses.bhavadeepa: सौम्येन लीनेनापि यत्कृतं तदाह- तस्येति। न्युब्जाः अधोमुखास्तथाऽचेष्टन्त यथोरगा नोत्थातुं शक्नुवन्तीत्यर्थः॥२९॥

verses.sanskrit: स राज्ञः पक्षपातेन मेने पतगसत्तमम्। ददर्श गरुडं प्राप्तं दिव्यस्रगनुलेपनम्॥३१॥
verses.english: Deathgod यम, an impounder everything with his baton, is now browbeaten with the baton of that demon in that war and got into a state wellnigh death, wherefore he repaired to his southerly region avoiding futile scrambling with that demon…

verses.sanskrit: पक्षवातेन पृथिवीं चालयन्तं मुहुर्मुहुः। पृष्ठासक्तैः प्रहरणैर्लेलिह्यन्तमिवोरगैः॥३२॥
verses.english: So far, firegod has set his face towards gods, since he has to pass on the offertories offered in the face and tongues of ritual-fire in vedic-rituals exclusively to gods… but काल-नेमि averted him from that posture, and turned the face of firegod towards his side, since all the vedic-oblations henceforth should belong to him alone… same is the case with airgod… taking control of airgod that demon made him to waft only to his tune…
verses.bhavadeepa: तान् राज्ञ इति सम्बन्धः। मेने मनसा पूजितवान्॥३१॥

verses.sanskrit: वैष्णवं हस्तसंश्लेषं मन्यमानैरवाङ्मुखैः। चरणाभ्यां प्रकर्षन्तं पाण्डुरं भोगिनां वरम्॥३३॥
verses.english: That tumulus war between gods and demons is calamitous since it is fraught with missiles and grapplers, also replete with obtuse weapons like clubs, maces, cudgels etc, of them numerous are already discharged, and innumerable are yet to be discharged as they are still now being brandished…

verses.sanskrit: हेमपत्रैरुपचितं धातुमन्तमिवाचलम्। अमृतारम्भहर्तारं द्विजिह्वेन्द्रविनाशनम्॥३४॥
verses.english: Though god kubera is a mace-fighter he is trounced with death like mace of that demon, whereby kubera had to forgo his godhood for wealth management… and quarter-guards too lost their lordship on ten quarters they are guarding so far…

verses.sanskrit: त्रासनं दैत्यसङ्घानां वाहनं ध्वजलक्षणम्। तं दृष्ट्वा स ध्वजं प्राप्तं सचिवं साम्परायिकम्॥३५॥
verses.english: Deathgod यम, an impounder everything with his baton, is now browbeaten with the baton of that demon in that war and got into a state wellnigh death, wherefore he repaired to his southerly region avoiding futile scrambling with that demon…

verses.sanskrit: धृतिमन्तं गरुत्मन्तं जगाद मधुसूदनः। दृष्ट्वा परमसंहृष्टः स्थितं देवमिवापरम्॥३६॥
verses.english: Intimadating the quarter-गुअर्द्-gods काल-नेमि usurped their functions into his hands, devised four more entities from his own being, and entrusted those usurped functions of guarding directions to those newly created selfsame entities – and ruled quarters for himself…

verses.sanskrit:
तुल्यसामर्थ्यया वाचा गरुत्मन्तमवस्थितम्।
              श्रीकृष्ण उवाच।
              स्वागतं खेचरश्रेष्ठ सुरसेनारिमर्दन। विनताहृदयानन्द स्वागतं केशवप्रिय॥३७॥
verses.english: Ecliptic-demon राहु, aka स्वर्भानु ushering him, काल-नेमि went to milky ways, appropriated the magnificence and ascendancy of moon, relegated the moon from the avenues to heaven and then he himself started to shine like moon… so is the case with sun… काल-नेमि took possession of solar path, orbit, and his diurnal functions, wherefore that demon himself started to blaze like sun, as well…

verses.sanskrit: व्रज पत्ररथश्रेष्ठ कैशिकस्य निवेशनम्। वयं तत्रैव गत्वाद्य प्रतीक्षाम स्वयंवरम्॥३८॥
verses.english: So far, firegod has set his face towards gods, since he has to pass on the offertories offered in the face and tongues of ritual-fire in vedic-rituals exclusively to gods… but काल-नेमि averted him from that posture, and turned the face of firegod towards his side, since all the vedic-oblations henceforth should belong to him alone… same is the case with airgod… taking control of airgod that demon made him to waft only to his tune…

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञां तत्र समेतानां हस्त्यश्वरथगामिनाम्। द्रक्ष्यामः शतशस्तत्र समेतानां महात्मनाम्॥३९॥
एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुर्वैनतेयं महाबलम्। जगामाथ पुरीं कृष्णः कैशिकस्य महात्मनः॥४०॥
वैनतेयसखः श्रीमान्यादवैश्च महारथैः। विदर्भनगरीं प्राप्ते कृष्णे देवकिनन्दने॥४१॥
हृष्टाः प्रमुदिताः सर्वे निवासायोपचक्रमुः। सर्वे शस्त्रायुधधरा राजानो बलशालिनः॥४२॥
verses.english: When demons extolled काल-नेमि on battlefield for his exploits, as a husbander of all created beings, as an all-inclusive world, as an all-in-one scare of the world, as a single-bodied quarter-guard-gods of ten quarters, as the soul of the sun, moon and all other planets, as a subverter of air and fire gods, and as one who on conquering all worlds ascended to the seat of creator brahma, bringing original brahma to naught… that demon काल-नेमि shone forth on battlefield as de facto brahma…

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु राजा नयविशारदः। कैशिकस्तत उत्थाय प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना॥४३॥
अर्घ्यमाचमनं दत्त्वा स राजा कैशिकः स्वयम्। सत्कृत्य विधिवत्कृष्णं स्वपुरं सम्प्रवेशयत्॥४४॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the forty-seventh chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the valour of demon काल-नेमि in starwars

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वमेव तु कृष्णाय कारितं दिव्यमन्दिरम्। विवेश सबलः श्रीमान्कैलासं शङ्करो यथा। खाद्यपानादिरत्नौघैरर्चितो वासवानुजः॥४५॥
सुखेन उषितः कृष्णस्तस्य राज्ञो निवेशने। पूजितो बहुमानेन स्नेहपूर्णेन चेतसा॥४६॥
verses.english: When kAla-nemi terrorised them in this way in that war, even if gods are capable they did not try either to retaliate, or to surrender, or to retreat – or anything… such is their despondency…
